in_marathi.name: Yokesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yokesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Yokesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Yoga' which means 'Joy'. The name Yokesh is thus a name that symbolizes joy, happiness, and positivity.

in_bengali.name: Yokesh
in_bengali.long_meaning: Yokesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Yokesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Yoga' which means 'Joy'. The name Yokesh is thus a name that symbolizes joy, happiness, and positivity.
